clean_registry_registration_chain.conclusion: Source explains the fresh-fixture exception without asserting an unqueried runtime row. Confirm enabled/version/path with the public read-only API before changing fixture state; do not label theme permanently unavailable.
clean_registry_registration_chain.constructor_lookup: xbmc/interfaces/legacy/Addon.cpp:54-69 requests GetAddon(...OnlyEnabled::CHOICE_YES). AddonManager.cpp:631-652 rejects disabled entries and Python raises Unknown addon id.
clean_registry_registration_chain.discovery: Pinned CAddonMgr::FindAddons scans visible special://xbmcbin/addons, special://xbmc/addons and special://home/addons descriptors, then calls CAddonDatabase::SyncInstalled. Manifest omission is not a global addon-discovery blacklist.
clean_registry_registration_chain.fresh_database_default: SyncInstalled inserts each newly discovered addon with enabled=0 unless its id is in the mandatory or optional system manifest. Therefore a newly discovered exact compat0.7.2 defaults disabled on this clean APK.
clean_registry_registration_chain.module_bootstrap: The original signed80 module bootstrap installs/authenticates four script.infinity.* ids only; it does not register/enable compat. A successful complete80 admission does not establish the optional compat owner enabled.
clean_registry_registration_chain.system_manifest: service.infinity.compat is neither mandatory nor optional in exact signed69 assets/system/addon-manifest.xml.

conditional_fixture_resolution.if_enabled_exact_072: Do not reinstall. Re-read the public theme owner and effective publisher state; investigate actual mismatch if Python still cannot resolve it.
conditional_fixture_resolution.if_existing_exact_disabled_072: After runtime identity matches the signed69 asset, root may choose ordinary Kodi enabling of that existing addon to restore the public owner dependency. This is a fixture/runtime-state action, not an APK/source patch; it has not been performed here.
conditional_fixture_resolution.if_missing_or_other_version_or_custom_so: Do not duplicate-install, downgrade, overwrite, fabricate an addon id or silently substitute the partial0.8.2 checkpoint ZIP. Preserve the evidence and let root decide a separately scoped fixture path.
conditional_fixture_resolution.not_a_permanent_blocker: The exact0.7.2 code is a known original baseline participant. No source evidence found of a global retirement/ban of this addon; generic fresh-addon disabled policy alone is not retirement.
conditional_fixture_resolution.not_equivalent_without_observation: Enabling is more than telemetry registration. It can start the compat primary service and its writer/checkpoint obligations; opening the menu or saving theme_mode alone does not establish effective Light/Dark rendering or reproduce an unknown owner-device installed addon version.

conditional_read_only_probe_plan.why: Pinned AddonsOperations.cpp:132-144 uses OnlyEnabled::CHOICE_NO, so this read can resolve disabled entries that Python Addon cannot.

conditional_read_only_probe_plan.when: Only if the single-id result needs clarification; find exact id, do not infer from the Python exception.

conditional_read_only_probe_plan.read_only_identity: Read the returned actual source root without importing/running the addon. Require id0.7.2 addon.xml plus every source/resource member in complete_signed69_compat_asset_member_sha256 to match the signed APK. Record actual path and enabled flag; no settings or userdata reads are needed for source identity.

declared_service_effects_and_checkpoint_.actual_automatic_launch_caveat: The descriptor declares three xbmc.service extensions, but pinned AddonInfoBuilder.cpp selects m_types[0]/first libname, AddonInfo::Type returns first matching type, and CServiceAddonManager starts one LibPath per addon id. For this descriptor the primary lib is service.py. Ordinary enabling alone does NOT prove layout_service.py or theme_contract.py automatically launched. Observe actual ThemeReady/revision/palette publication; do not assume three daemons or inject a replacement dispatcher.
declared_service_effects_and_checkpoint_.checkpoint_provenance: All three declared entrypoint hashes and the service.py dependency closure appear exactly in pinned InfinityScriptCheckpointContracts.cpp:72-82. This is existing participation, not permission to remove or weaken checkpoints.

public_CC_theme_contract.failure_boundary: The Addon constructor is unguarded before choose(Infinity Theme), so a disabled/missing owner prevents this public theme menu, not merely optional observer telemetry. The `or system` fallback handles empty setting values only; it does not catch Unknown addon id.
public_CC_theme_contract.normal_write_path: Selection light/dark/system -> existing common.addon_set_setting(service.infinity.compat,theme_mode,value) -> fresh owner setting readback; existing checkpoint persistence scope retained. No direct Home-property policy spoofing.

public_CC_theme_contract.separate_public_dark_variant: RunScript(script.infinity.commandcenter,dark-appearance) uses existing Dark Mode Appearance selector and protected Skin.SetString(Infinity.DarkAppearance,original|oled); this branch does not construct the compat addon but does not replace Light/Dark theme-policy coverage.

read_only_public_fallbacks.interpretation: Read these properties without constructing the optional addon; blank/unavailable values remain unknown. They observe effective/raw state and do not prove the manual requested owner policy was selected.
read_only_public_fallbacks.raw_vs_effective: Infinity.NativeSystemTheme is raw host fact. theme_contract.publish writes effective Infinity.Theme and compatibility Infinity.SystemTheme, palette values, then signature/revision/ThemeReady=true.
read_only_public_fallbacks.theme_contract_fallback: _addon_value catches a provided addon object setting-read failure and defaults to system. _effective_theme uses manual light/dark/oled or raw NativeSystemTheme when bridge>=5; missing/invalid raw theme falls back dark. These functions must actually run; passive property reads do not execute this fallback.
